subject: Re: Did your bank details change?
text:
Hi Melissa,

Thanks for checking with us. No, Brightline has NOT changed its bank details, and we have no plans to. Please continue paying us by ACH to the account you already have on file (Chase, ending 5555).

If you receive any email claiming our banking has changed, please treat it as fraud and call me directly at the number on our website.

Best,
Carla Benson
Credit & Collections
Brightline Office Supply Inc

> On Mon, Nov 9, 2026, Melissa Grant <mgrant@larkspur-ind.com> wrote:
> Hi Carla, we got an email that looked like it came from Brightline saying your bank changed. Can you confirm whether that's real?
label: ordinary
note: Vendor confirms nothing changed; heavy use of 'bank details', 'changed', 'continue paying'.
